scope: Installed Codex Desktop local stdio path; alternative capture route, not selected for implementation

provenance.method: Partial REA analysis followed by focused reads of packaged JavaScript
provenance.rea_coverage: Partial: main module semantic analysis exceeded 1024 MiB; do not interpret as complete semantic recovery
provenance.offset_unit: Zero-based Python string character offset in the decoded source, not a byte offset
provenance.contents: Metadata only; no conversation content, generated text, raw TRACE records or full analysis exports

static_findings.claim: Desktop passes RUST_LOG from its process environment to the local CLI; defaults LOG_FORMAT to json
Local stdio stderr data is routed to the connection error callback as a message; chunks are trimmed
Local non-reconnecting connection writes CLI stderr to Desktop debug logger under safe.message
CODEX_MAX_LOG_LEVEL controls Desktop filtering; prod defaults to info
Accepted Desktop logs are written through a rotating file stream; backpressure can drop lines
macOS log root is Library/Logs/<bundle id>; defaults are 10 MiB per segment, five segments, fifteen-day retention

unverified: Completeness of streamed tool arguments and text
Original event timestamps and correct thread/turn attribution
